title: Decision-readiness — one row per requirement
requirement: Put a decision-readiness table on the landing page: one row per requirement, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it.
notes: Identity and status come from data/requirements.json (asserted at build time). Blockers cite published question/flag/gate ids. Clearing numbers are this repo's own verification counts; where a threshold is a proposal it is marked proposed.
